scope: Actual map terrain, original water/flower/cloud shaders and shared environment; camera near saved FlowerPatch, disable/re-enable and resize checks. Linux software Vulkan; not complete game/class or device visual acceptance.

water.scope: Original Plane10x10 saved transform consumer and OceanMesh variants, original WaterSim/Reset two-target GLSL with GPU history and restored material wind scroll. Editor camera grid focus; zero Avatar contact impulses until its original query is connected. Preview sky probe and empty point-light grid; full world ocean geometry, scene reflections, Ocean lifecycle and Metal image parity remain pending

flowers.scope: Original Flower point GLSL; native-verified RG texture, seed setup, 32-byte generation and whole Update including 300-per-frame growth budget, general pool, LOD/fade/free and mapped vertices. Editor BVH ground tracing/OBB overlap, camera/frustum-only Visibility and GPU map/allocator services use actual terrain/material/first-vertex lighting. FlowerShadow, native collision/spatial jobs/occlusion, complete GPU owner/resource lifecycle and game image acceptance remain pending.
